description: Makes a new public board on one connected Pinterest account, with a name and a description. Boards made here are always public: a secret board is refused (public_boards_only), so tell the user they can make it secret on Pinterest afterwards. Ask the user before creating or changing a board, and show them its name and description first. It is made once: if the answer is unclear, read boards_list before trying again, or the account gets two. Answers the new board: its id, its name and secret: false. Pins go to it when a draft names it in options.board, or every pin once accounts_board chooses it.

accountId.description: A connected Pinterest account id from accounts_list.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

description.description: What the board is about, up to 500 characters. Shown under its name on Pinterest. Left out, it has none.

name.description: The board’s name as it shows on Pinterest, up to 80 characters. Use a name the account has no board under yet.

name: boards_create
title: Make a Pinterest board
